dag1.text: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. BOFN, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.spoken: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. B O F N, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.phonemes: ˈiːtʃ kæmpˈeɪn ɪz ɐ fˈʌŋkʃən nˈɛtwɜːk: ɐ tʃˈeɪn ʌv stˈɛps, wˌɛɹ ˈiːtʃ stˈɛps ɹɪzˈʌlts fˈiːd ðə nˈɛkst. bˈiː ˈoʊ ˈɛf ˈɛn, beɪˈiːʒən ˌɑːptɪmᵻzˈeɪʃən ˌoʊvɚ fˈʌŋkʃən nˈɛtwɜːks, mˈɑːdəlz ˈɛvɹi stˈɛp, nˌɑːt dʒˈʌst ðə fˈaɪnəl skˈɔːɹ.

exp1.text: Here is each step itself, for one alloy from each campaign: the experiment, and the data it makes. Everything is simulated by the twin, unless a label says otherwise.
exp1.spoken: Here is each step itself, for one alloy from each campaign: the experiment, and the data it makes. Everything is simulated by the twin, unless a label says otherwise.
exp1.phonemes: hˈɪɹ ɪz ˈiːtʃ stˈɛp ɪtsˈɛlf, fɔːɹ wˈʌn ˈælɔɪ fɹʌm ˈiːtʃ kæmpˈeɪn: ðɪ ɛkspˈɛɹɪmənt, ænd ðə dˈeɪɾə ɪt mˈeɪks. ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ɪz sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd baɪ ðə twˈɪn, ʌnlˈɛs ɐ lˈeɪbəl sˈɛz ˈʌðɚwˌaɪz.

comp1.text: The aluminium alloy is design number 299: aluminium with eight additions, manganese and chromium the largest.
comp1.spoken: The aluminum alloy is design number 299: aluminum with eight additions, manganese and chromium the largest.
comp1.phonemes: ðɪ ɐlˈuːmɪnəm ˈælɔɪ ɪz dɪzˈaɪn nˈʌmbɚ tˈuːhˈʌndɹɪd nˈaɪnti nˈaɪn: ɐlˈuːmɪnəm wɪð ˈeɪt ɐdˈɪʃənz, mˈæŋɡənˌiːz ænd kɹˈoʊmiəm ðə lˈɑːɹdʒɪst.

comp2.text: On this map of the search space, it is one of 435 designs the run simulated.
comp2.spoken: On this map of the search space, it is one of 435 designs the run simulated.
comp2.phonemes: ˌɔn ðɪs mˈæp ʌvðə sˈɜːtʃ spˈeɪs, ɪɾ ɪz wˈʌn ʌv fˈɔːɹhˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾi fˈaɪv dɪzˈaɪnz ðə ɹˈʌn sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd.

comp3.text: The copper alloy is design number 74: an aluminium bronze, with a little nickel and titanium.
comp3.spoken: The copper alloy is design number 74: an aluminum bronze, with a little nickel and titanium.
comp3.phonemes: ðə kˈɑːpɚɹ ˈælɔɪ ɪz dɪzˈaɪn nˈʌmbɚ sˈɛvənti fˈɔːɹ: ɐn ɐlˈuːmɪnəm bɹˈɑːnz, wɪð ɐ lˈɪɾəl nˈɪkəl ænd taɪtˈeɪniəm.

sch1.text: CALPHAD comes first. As the melt cools, a Scheil model follows how much of it has frozen. This curve is the one the optimizer sees.
sch1.spoken: CALPHAD comes first. As the melt cools, a Scheil model follows how much of it has frozen. This curve is the one the optimizer sees.
sch1.phonemes: kˈælfæd kˈʌmz fˈɜːst. æz ðə mˈɛlt kˈuːlz, ɐ ʃˈaɪl mˈɑːdəl fˈɑːloʊz hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ ʌv ɪt hɐz fɹˈoʊzən. ðɪs kˈɜːv ɪz ðə wˈʌn ðɪ ˈɑːptɪmˌaɪzɚ sˈiːz.

sch2.text: A full Scheil run on an open database adds the phases as they form. The twin's hidden truth differs again, as a real alloy would.
sch2.spoken: A full Scheil run on an open database adds the phases as they form. The twin's hidden truth differs again, as a real alloy would.
sch2.phonemes: ɐ fˈʊl ʃˈaɪl ɹˈʌn ˌɔn ɐn ˈoʊpən dˈeɪɾəbˌeɪs ˈædz ðə fˈeɪzᵻz æz ðeɪ fˈɔːɹm. ðə twˈɪnz hˈɪdən tɹˈuːθ dˈɪfɚz ɐɡˈɛn, æz ɐ ɹˈiːəl ˈælɔɪ wˈʊd.

sch3.text: From its curve, the network takes two numbers: the liquidus, and a hot-cracking index.
sch3.spoken: From its curve, the network takes two numbers: the liquidus, and a hot-cracking index.
sch3.phonemes: fɹʌm ɪts kˈɜːv, ðə nˈɛtwɜːk tˈeɪks tˈuː nˈʌmbɚz: ðə lˈɪkwɪdəs, ænd ɐ hˈɑːtkɹˈækɪŋ ˈɪndɛks.

sch4.text: Every run in round three b used this open node. The Thermo-Calc stand-in was never bought.
sch4.spoken: Every run in round three b used this open node. The Thermo-Calc stand-in was never bought.
sch4.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi ɹˈʌn ɪn ɹˈaʊnd θɹˈiː bˈiː jˈuːzd ðɪs ˈoʊpən nˈoʊd. ðə θˈɜːməkˈælk stˈændɪn wʌz nˈɛvɚ bˈɔːt.

am1.text: The twin stands in for the AM module with a moving point source of heat. It gives the melt pool's width and depth, and how fast the metal cools.
am1.spoken: The twin stands in for the AM module with a moving point source of heat. It gives the melt pool's width and depth, and how fast the metal cools.
am1.phonemes: ðə twˈɪn stˈændz ɪn fɚðə ˌeɪ ˈɛm mˈɑːdʒuːl wɪð ɐ mˈuːvɪŋ pˈɔɪnt sˈɔːɹs ʌv hˈiːt. ɪt ɡˈɪvz ðə mˈɛlt pˈuːlz wˈɪtθ ænd dˈɛpθ, ænd hˌaʊ fˈæst ðə mˈɛɾəl kˈuːlz.

am2.text: This is not Thermo-Calc output, and no run bought this node. But the same model decides the porosity of every simulated build.
am2.spoken: This is not Thermo-Calc output, and no run bought this node. But the same model decides the porosity of every simulated build.
am2.phonemes: ðɪs ɪz nˌɑːt θˈɜːməkˈælk ˈaʊtpʊt, ænd nˈoʊ ɹˈʌn bˈɔːt ðɪs nˈoʊd. bˌʌt ðə sˈeɪm mˈɑːdəl dᵻsˈaɪdz ðə pɔːɹˈɔsᵻɾi ʌv ˈɛvɹi sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd bˈɪld.

dag2.text: For aluminium, the lab makes each alloy's powder itself, then prints it and checks every build.
dag2.spoken: For aluminum, the lab makes each alloy's powder itself, then prints it and checks every build.
dag2.phonemes: fɔːɹ ɐlˈuːmɪnəm, ðə lˈæb mˌeɪks ˈiːtʃ ˈælɔɪz pˈaʊdɚɹ ɪtsˈɛlf, ðˈɛn pɹˈɪnts ɪt ænd tʃˈɛks ˈɛvɹi bˈɪld.

atm1.text: This footage is real: our own atomizer, running a bronze. The size distribution beside it is the twin's, for this alloy.
atm1.spoken: This footage is real: our own atomizer, running a bronze. The size distribution beside it is the twin's, for this alloy.

atm2.text: Here, one of three runs failed, and 13 percent of the charge ended up in the printer's size range.
atm2.spoken: Here, one of three runs failed, and 13 percent of the charge ended up in the printer's size range.
atm2.phonemes: hˈɪɹ, wˈʌn ʌv θɹˈiː ɹˈʌnz fˈeɪld, ænd θˈɜːtiːn pɚsˈɛnt ʌvðə tʃˈɑːɹdʒ ˈɛndᵻd ˌʌp ɪnðə pɹˈɪntɚz sˈaɪz ɹˈeɪndʒ.

prt1.text: One build is nine cubes, each at its own laser power and speed.
prt1.spoken: One build is nine cubes, each at its own laser power and speed.
prt1.phonemes: wˈʌn bˈɪld ɪz nˈaɪn kjˈuːbz, ˈiːtʃ æɾ ɪts ˈoʊn lˈeɪzɚ pˈaʊɚ ænd spˈiːd.

prt2.text: Each cube's density and crack reading goes on the map. Too little energy leaves lack of fusion. Too much makes keyhole pores.
prt2.spoken: Each cube's density and crack reading goes on the map. Too little energy leaves lack of fusion. Too much makes keyhole pores.

prt3.spoken: One build gives the network's print node nine data points.
prt3.phonemes: wˈʌn bˈɪld ɡˈɪvz ðə nˈɛtwɜːks pɹˈɪnt nˈoʊd nˈaɪn dˈeɪɾə pˈɔɪnts.

sem1.text: In the SEM, one electron beam scans the sample line by line, and four detectors each catch a different signal.
sem1.spoken: In the S E M, one electron beam scans the sample line by line, and four detectors each catch a different signal.
sem1.phonemes: ɪnðɪ ˈɛs ˈiː ˈɛm, wˈʌn ᵻlˈɛktɹɑːn bˈiːm skˈænz ðə sˈæmpəl lˈaɪn baɪ lˈaɪn, ænd fˈɔːɹ dɪtˈɛktɚz ˈiːtʃ kˈætʃ ɐ dˈɪfɹənt sˈɪɡnəl.

sem2.text: Secondary electrons show the powder's surface. Backscattered electrons show the section's pores and cracks. X-rays give the elements, and diffraction gives each grain's orientation.
sem2.spoken: Secondary electrons show the powder's surface. Backscattered electrons show the section's pores and cracks. X-rays give the elements, and diffraction gives each grain's orientation.

sem3.text: Every image here is simulated by the twin, for this alloy.

sem4.spoken: The network uses three of them: satellites on the powder, the section's pores and cracks, and the grain size. E D S only checks the composition.

mec1.text: Bars are heat treated, then pulled. The furnace profile here is only illustrative: the twin models the strength it leaves.

mec3.text: Yield strength, 349 megapascals, and elongation, 10.1 percent, are the two numbers the network keeps.

dag3.text: For copper, a one-hour corrosion screen ranks the DED deposits, and thirty days in seawater come before a utility is known.
dag3.spoken: For copper, a one-hour corrosion screen ranks the D E D deposits, and thirty days in seawater come before a utility is known.
